title: Shelves for the workshop
transcript:
Samir Adeyemi (owner): The workshop wall needs shelves before the weekend class.
Samir Adeyemi (owner): I'll pay Cedar Lumber $410 for the shelf lumber this week.
Samir Adeyemi (owner): I'll pay Parcel Desk $36 for the hardware shipping.
Riley Brooks (Cedar Lumber): We can take 560 Canadian dollars instead, if you want.
Samir Adeyemi (owner): No, keep the Cedar Lumber bill in dollars.
Riley Brooks (Cedar Lumber): We should also hire a painter for $200.
Samir Adeyemi (owner): Not this month.

traps.description: Riley offers 560 Canadian dollars and Samir says to keep the bill in dollars.
Riley suggests a painter for $200 and Samir says not this month.
